program.name: Bell Push Pull Legs
program.subject: Kettlebell only
program.blurb: Push, pull and legs with a single kettlebell, in straight sets.
program.about: The classic three-day split with one kettlebell. Push day presses, pull day rows and pulls, legs day squats, lunges and swings, each in straight sets with core work along the way. Three days rotate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds.
program.split: Bell push / bell pull / bell legs
